title: Waruchiri (Huarochirí Manuscript), Runasimi.de edition
notes: Quechua text of the Huarochirí Manuscript (c. 1600) in the Runasimi.de reworking, with revised spelling, based on Gerald Taylor's 1976 edition 'Ritos y Tradiciones de Huarochirí'. The same manuscript in Taylor's 1987 edition is catalogued separately as huarochiri-quechua-full.
